ETS 启动后，助手会自动打开并开始监听。: After ETS starts, the assistant opens automatically and begins monitoring.
重构 UI，基于 WinUI 3 实现的解决方案，新增大量功能。: Rebuilt the UI with a WinUI 3 solution and added many new features.
选择浅色、深色或跟随系统。: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.
更改会立即应用并保存。: Changes take effect immediately and are saved.
监听器会在 Windows 登录时后台启动。: The listener starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.
启动 ETS 并打开试卷后，这里会显示答题进度和本地答案。: Open a paper in ETS to see progress and local answers here.
手动重置：在 ETS 中切到第 1 题后点击，助手会清空本轮进度并从当前题目重新: Manual reset: switch to question 1 in ETS, then click to clear this attempt and answer again from the current question.
打开 ETS 时启动助手窗口、试卷转换监听和答题监听。关闭 ETS 后，后台进程: Opening ETS starts the assistant window, paper converter and answer listener. They stop when ETS closes.
查看本机试卷，打开目录、提取答案或删除。: Browse local papers, open folders, extract answers or delete.
还没有本机试卷。打开 ETS 并进入一份试卷后，这里会自动出现记录。: No local papers yet. Open a paper in ETS and it will appear here.
调整答题行为，保存后由监听器读取。: Adjust answering behavior; the listener reads these settings.
每题按此概率选择试卷包中的正确答案。: Each question uses this probability to pick the local correct answer.
相同种子会产生可复现的选择结果。: The same seed produces reproducible choices.
设置“下一步/跳过”按钮重试的最短间隔。: Minimum delay between retries of Next/Skip.
登录 Windows 时在后台启动监听器: Start the listener in the background at Windows sign-in
开启后会等待 ETS 启动；ETS 打开时自动显示助手窗口。: When enabled, it waits for ETS and shows the assistant window when ETS opens.
用于口语题测试，模型 deepseek-flash。密钥使用 Windows D: For speaking tests with deepseek-flash. The key is encrypted with Windows DPAPI and stored only on this PC; it never enters the config file or repository.
标答模式（提取试卷推荐答案，供 TTS 使用）: Standard mode (use the pack's model answer for TTS)
标答模式不调用 DeepSeek；灵活模式使用上面的 API Key 和 llm: Standard mode skips DeepSeek; flexible mode uses the API key above and llm_stt.md.
标答模式不调用 DeepSeek；生成模式使用上面的 API Key 和 llm: Standard mode skips DeepSeek; generated mode uses the API key above and llm_stt.md.
自动完成开始、跳过放音、开录、播放 TTS、停止和下一题；练习结束后自动清理 t: Automatically starts the practice, skips prompt playback, records, plays TTS, stops, and advances. Temp audio is cleaned after the practice ends. ETS must be on a speaking question and the paper's TTS must be pre-generated.
把 TTS 生成的 WAV 转成 16-bit / 48 kHz，然后让 ETS: Converts a TTS WAV to 16-bit / 48 kHz, then launches ETS with Chromium's fake-microphone switches so ETS records this WAV as microphone input. Close ETS first.
先在上方选择试卷，再按当前口语模式（标答/灵活）为每题生成答案并合成 TTS。全: Select a paper above, then generate an answer for every speaking question with the current mode (standard/flexible) and synthesize TTS. During recording, play each WAV to the virtual cable's CABLE Input; ETS must use CABLE Output as its microphone.
“播放到虚拟声卡”是静音的，只给 ETS 录音用；要自己听请点“本地试听”。: "Play to virtual cable" is silent and only feeds ETS; use "Preview locally" to hear it.
选择题和听力自动答题相关的调试端口与日志工具。: Debug-port and log tools for automatic choice/listening answering.
口语题分析、DeepSeek 生成、TTS 合成和虚拟声卡播放。: Speaking-question analysis, DeepSeek generation, TTS synthesis and virtual-cable playback.
运行日志、抓包、程序信息和重置操作。: Runtime logs, packet capture, app information and reset operations.
停止后台监听并移除开机启动和快捷方式，清除 DeepSeek/阿里云凭证、界面偏: Stops the listener, removes autostart and shortcuts, and clears DeepSeek/Aliyun credentials, UI preferences, virtual-microphone WAV and assistant logs. Exam packs, answer history and answer records are kept.
模型 deepseek-flash。每次请求都会附带题干和 llm_stt.md: Model deepseek-flash. Every request includes the question stem and the llm_stt.md attachment; the reply shows only the model output.
输入口语题干，例如：朗读下面这段话……: Enter a speaking prompt, e.g. Read the following passage…
在此输入 RAM AccessKey ID、AccessKey Secret 和: Enter the RAM AccessKey ID, AccessKey Secret and Intelligent Speech Interaction project AppKey here. The assistant first tries to save the credentials securely on this PC; if Windows blocks persistent storage, they remain available for this session only. The NLS token is obtained and refreshed automatically.
状态：阿里云凭证已加密保存在本机。: Status: Alibaba Cloud credentials are encrypted and stored on this PC.
状态：凭证仅在本次运行期间有效，关闭助手后需要重新输入。: Status: credentials are valid for this session only; re-enter them after closing the assistant.
状态：尚未配置阿里云 TTS 凭证。: Status: Alibaba Cloud TTS credentials are not configured.
保存并启用阿里云凭证: Save and enable Alibaba Cloud credentials
助手会在本机通过 SDK 获取并缓存 NLS Token，在过期前自动续取。: The assistant obtains and caches an NLS token through the SDK, then refreshes it before expiration.
凭证仅在本次运行期间启用: Credentials enabled for this session only
当前 Windows 环境拒绝持久保存。关闭助手后凭证会从内存清除，下次使用时请: Windows blocked persistent storage. The credentials will be cleared from memory when the assistant closes; enter them again next time.
本机保存的阿里云 TTS 凭证已删除。: The Alibaba Cloud TTS credentials saved on this PC have been deleted.
阿里云标准 TTS · Betty 美式英文女声 · WAV 16 kHz。超过: Alibaba Cloud standard TTS · Betty American English female voice · WAV 16 kHz. Text over 300 characters is split into requests and joined.
阿里云 TTS 生成并播放: Generate and play with Alibaba Cloud TTS
阿里云 TTS 凭证已在本机加密保存；Token 由 SDK 自动获取并按过期时: Alibaba Cloud TTS credentials are encrypted locally; the SDK obtains and refreshes tokens based on expiration.
尚未配置阿里云 TTS 凭证，请在开发者页填写并加密保存。: Alibaba Cloud TTS is not configured. Enter and securely save the credentials on the Developer Tools page.
监听器、转换和答题进程的最近状态。: Recent status of the listener, converter and answer workers.
从界面管理监听、试卷和答题选项。: Manage monitoring, papers and answer options from the UI.
1. 确认 ETS 已安装，程序会自动查找常见安装位置和 Windows 安装记: 1. Make sure ETS is installed. The app checks common locations and Windows install records.
2. 将数字编号试卷包放入 %APPDATA%\\ETS，并保留原有 JSON: 2. Place numeric paper packs in %APPDATA%\ETS and keep their JSON files and folder structure.
3. 使用“初始化并打开 ETS”创建快捷方式、启动后台监听并打开 ETS。以后: 3. Use Initialize and open ETS to create shortcuts, start the listener and open ETS. It then waits in the background.
4. ETS 启动时助手窗口会自动弹出；试卷转换结果保存在试卷包的 conver: 4. The assistant window opens with ETS. Converted papers are saved under each pack's converted folder.
答题辅助依赖 ETS 本机调试接口。程序不会自动点击最终提交按钮。: Answering uses the local ETS debugging endpoint. The app never clicks the final submit button.
开发者用的端口、日志和程序信息工具。: Developer tools for ports, logs and app information.
ETS 需要使用 --remote-debugging-port=10086 启: ETS must run with --remote-debugging-port=10086. Open ETS if the port is unavailable.
启用后连接 10086 的 DevTools 网络域。每次检测到答题提交完成，会: Connects to the 10086 DevTools network domain. After a submission is detected, it waits 3 seconds and appends recent packets to the capture file, which is included in log exports.
等待 ETS 调试端口…: Waiting for the ETS debug port…
导出会把数据目录中的日志、配置和当前环境信息打包为 ZIP。: Export bundles logs, configuration and environment information from the data folder into a ZIP.
